Name: JP's Sounds of the Valley - New Sounds and Ambient
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][size=6][i][u][b][size=6][color=#00ff00][i][u][center]Sounds of the Valley﻿[/center][/u][/i][/color][/size][/b][/u][/i][/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Based on mod '[/size][/b][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2760]SFX Replacement -- Better Tool Sounds and Real Thunder[/url]'.[/size][/b]
[size=4]Easily replace most sounds with improved ones. Contains a wide variety of improved sounds compared to its predecessor.[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][u][b]
See the 'Videos' tab for a preview of the new sounds and comparisons.[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=4][i]The video was updated with all the new content from version 3.0.0 (10/13/2024)[/i][/size][/color]
[/list][i][list]
[*][size=4][i][b][color=#f4f4f4]Stardew Valley 1.6 [/color][color=#ff7700]Custom Music[/color][color=#f4f4f4] is no longer used. [/color][/b][/i][/size]
[*][size=4][i][b][color=#f4f4f4]'[/color][color=#ff7700]Sound Tweaker[/color][color=#f4f4f4]' is still required, it has not yet been updated but still works excellent in this new version of the game. [/color][/b][/i][/size]
[*][size=5][i][b][color=#ff0000][u]If you have any problem, don't hesitate to report it.[/u][/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][/b][/i][/size]
[/list][/i][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]
[b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4][b]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/b][/size][size=4]
[/size][i]
[size=4]-------------------------------------------------------------------
You can support me at [url=https://ko-fi.com/juanpa98ar]Ko-Fi[/url] or [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/juanpa98ar]BuyMeACoffee[/url]!

Downloads.Description:
*Sound Tweaker*
REMOVE PREVIOUS VERSIONS BEFORE INSTALLING.
Unzip and move to the mods folder.
This part of the mod contains the sounds that replace the in-game sound effects.

Manifest.Name: (CP) New Effect Sounds
Manifest.Description: Replace default sounds with better sounds
Manifest.Author: Juanpa98ar

Downloads.Description:
*Sound Tweaker*
Unzip and move to the mods folder.
This part of the mod contains the sounds that replace the ambient sounds of the game.
This version is quite limited compared to CM. Use it if Custom Music gives you problems.

Manifest.Name: (CP) New Ambient Sounds
Manifest.Description: Replace default ambient with better sounds
Manifest.Author: Juanpa98ar

Downloads.Description:
*Custom Music*
Unzip and move to the mods folder.
This part of the mod contains the sounds that replace the ambient sounds of the game.
This version handles ambient sounds better than Sound Tweaker. Use if you have no problems with Custom Music.

Manifest.Name: (CM) New Ambient Sounds
Manifest.Description: Replace default ambient with better sounds
Manifest.Author: Juanpa98ar

Downloads.Description:
UNINSTALL PREVIOUS VERSIONS BEFORE INSTALLING THE NEW VERSION.
Unzip and move to the mods folder. If you like the mod don't forget to hit the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page, it helps me a lot and it's free :D
